name: stress-fault
description: Stress test faults (request §35-49): the reconnect churn at 50 players (half of the leavers drop without a disconnect packet), the disconnect spike (50 at once, mixed), 8 input timeouts at once among 50, invalid packets at 50/s from 10 % abusers, the mixed network faults at 50, and the DB: records written under load (db_persistence) and MySQL down and back (db_down). The DB scenarios need the project's MySQL container running (docker compose start mysql) and are SKIPPED otherwise. About 13 minutes (estimated from the single runs of 2026-10-02).
